name: Hero
description: Piqueray Hero (image), responsive. 3.0.0 (2026-09-07, vague 031 suite, page « Portes de garage »): re-extracted from the candidate set 2770:20976 (page 031, section « 031 · HERO IMAGE — 4 variantes (candidat v2) »), four `presentation` variants Mobile / Tablette / Desktop / Wide validated by the owner on 2026-09-07 — the anchors move from the single COMPONENT 2111:3382 to the set, hence MAJOR. Everything the canvas draws is proposed by `npm run extract:figma` on the dump v1.8 and adopted: layout per mode (Titres column centered on Mobile/Tablette, row bottom-aligned on Desktop/Wide), paddings and gap per mode as tokensByProp on the presentation axis (64/24 · 64/48 · 96-48/56 · 96-48/89, gap 24 · 24 · 32 · 32), the title riding the responsive text style H1 (typography.h1.* — SemiBold; the 2.0.0 master drew it Bold: weight change decided by the owner), the paragraph riding typography.body.* (Regular under 992, Medium above — typography.body.weight varies by viewport mode). Veils: the 2.0.0 Titres scrim (2 stops) is REMOVED (owner decision « B »); a new full-inset `Voile` plane carries the DS token color.noir-voile-55 (55 % black) PLUS a bottom gradient (0 → 30 % transparent, 0.8 at 100 %), and `VoileNavigation` reuses the HeroVideo top veil per mode. Added by hand, each named: the host element (section — not drawn), the text alignment per mode (center / left), the CTA pinned to the bottom edge on Mobile/Tablette (drawn ABSOLUTE on the canvas; the schema has no channel on a nested instance — Odoo projection, code-only), the flattening of the `Titre direct` wrapper frame. The drawn widths 390/834/1200/1728 are witnesses, not tokens: the root fills its parent. The photo keeps the 2.0.0 model (code-side `backgroundUrl`, `Background` plane, object-fit cover). Breakpoints are the token dimension `breakpoint.*` (768 / 992 / 1400), consumed by the CSS build, never by this contract.

props.name: presentation
props.description: Viewport presentation, mirroring the canvas axis Presentation of the 031 candidate set. Default = mobile, the first variant of the set (Figma's default) and the mobile-first base of the delivered CSS; in the delivered CSS the mode is selected by the viewport through the breakpoint tokens, never by a consumer.

props.name: backgroundUrl
props.description: Code-only source of the Background plane's photographic IMAGE fill. The set exposes no component property for it — A5 / §a.7 means the bitmap has no contract→canvas transport, so it rides a code-side scalar and the canvas keeps the engine's placeholder. Every page instance overrides the photo on the canvas (10 usages, each with its own image).

props.name: backgroundAlt
props.description: Alternative text for the background photo plane. Empty by default: the Figma paint is decorative — it carries no information the surrounding copy does not already state.

props.name: titre
props.description: Hero title, bound to the native TEXT property « Titre ». Stays rich-text (marks.strong governed) so the editor keeps bold available; the DEFAULT carries no bold segment — the 031 candidate draws the whole title uniform SemiBold (fontStyle SemiBold on the node, style H1). The 2.0.0 default (« Portes de garage » in bold) came from the old master and is dropped.

props.name: sousTitre
props.description: The hero paragraph as a governed rich-text prop bound to the native TEXT property « SousTitre » (016/T042). The two 700 ranges drawn on the candidate (« performance », « la solution idéale ») travel as segments; the Figma projection keeps one native TEXT value and reapplies the governed marks as native character ranges.

default.text: sans compromis, même en usage intensif. Atelier, bâtiment industriel, bâtiment public ou résidence : quelle que soit votre application, nous avons

props.name: sousTitre2
props.description: Figma « SousTitre2 » BOOLEAN property (visibility of the sousTitre node, carried by the 031 set as on the 2026-08-22 master). Affichage du sous-titre. Masquer le retire du flux : la colonne gauche se réduit au titre. Vider le texte ne suffit pas — un TEXT vide garde sa boîte de ligne dans Figma comme dans l'éditeur Odoo (mesuré 2026-08-22).

root.description: Root frame, row, gap space.10 (bound on the four variants), height size.hero.root (640, bound on the four variants), width FIXED per variant on the canvas (witness) — fill here, 1728 as authoring reference. Cross-axis: the dump reads counter MIN on Mobile/Tablette and MAX on Desktop/Wide; blocTexte is FIXED 640 = the root's own height on Mobile/Tablette, so `stretch` is the faithful CSS statement of that fill (named deviation from the literal MIN), and `end` on Desktop/Wide where blocTexte hugs its content at the bottom.

Background.description: The photo plane (canvas: frame « Background », IMAGE fill, FILL scale mode — the dump v1 does not carry IMAGE paints, degradation named). Out of flow (position: absolute) so it does not join the root's flex row; the emitter's replaced-element chrome then sizes it to the full inset box. object-fit: cover reproduces scaleMode FILL (centered); a framing gap against Figma's FILL at widths other than 1728 is possible and is measured, never corrected here. Declared FIRST so the later positioned siblings paint over it.

Voile.description: Full-inset veil « B » (owner decision 2026-09-07, judged on the clear photo of « Portes de garage »): a SOLID fill bound to the DS token color/noir-voile-55 (the token value #0000008C carries the 55 % alpha itself — the extraction note « alpha not representable on a token ref » is an extraction limit, the token is exact) PLUS a bottom linear gradient (black, alpha 0 from 0 to 30 %, 0.8 at 100 %) as the second paint. The dump v1 carries the first SOLID only (« paint-stack-truncated », expected): the gradient is read on the canvas and carried as a governed literal (named-literals registry). Sits above the photo and below VoileNavigation (same z-index, earlier in DOM order = painted first, as on the canvas). The drawn size 390…1728 × 640 is the root's own box: inset 0, never a token.

VoileNavigation.description: Top veil (navigation readability, the Page header overlays the hero). Owner decision 2026-09-07: the HeroVideo veil of the same mode — the values are the ones read on the HeroVideo 031 set on 2026-09-02 and carried by ds.hero-video (from 75 % to 0.65 on Mobile/Tablette, from 70 % to 0.58 on Desktop/Wide), literalsByProp on the presentation axis. The dump v1 does not carry GRADIENT paints (degradation named).

blocTexte.description: Content plane, column, gap space.16 (bound on the four variants). FILL width; FIXED 640 (= fill) height on Mobile/Tablette, HUG on Desktop/Wide — stretched / bottom-aligned by the root. Positioned above the veils.

Titres.description: Titles block. Mobile/Tablette: COLUMN, content centered on both axes (primary CENTER / counter CENTER), padding 64 top and bottom, gutter 24 / 48, gap 24 — the block fills the 640 height (FIXED = fill on the canvas, `grow` here). Desktop/Wide: ROW, bottom-aligned (counter MAX), padding 96 top / 48 bottom, gutter 56 / 89, gap 32. Every padding is bound on the four variants; the gap is bound on Mobile/Tablette (space/24) and RAW 32 on Desktop/Wide (extraction: « bound in 2/4 variants — not proposed ») — carried as space.32 on the owner's decision, source defect listed in the journal. The 2.0.0 scrim on this block (2 stops) is removed (owner decision 2026-09-07).

colGauche.description: Left column: title then paragraph, gap space.16 (bound on the four variants — was raw 16 on the 2.0.0 master). FILL width on the four variants; HUG height. On Desktop/Wide it absorbs the row's remaining width (grow) and is bottom-aligned with the CTA by the `align: end` of Titres. Named code-only fact: `grow` has no per-mode channel (layoutByProp carries direction/justify/align only), so in the Mobile/Tablette column the code surface stretches the column vertically (512 px instead of the drawn 216 / 128, title pushed to the top) — the Odoo projection resets flex to 0 0 auto under the desktop breakpoint (responsive/hero.pqr.css), exactly as HeroVideo's Text does. The canvas wraps the title in a `Titre direct` frame (column, gap space/8, one child): flattened here as in 2.0.0 — an envelope with a single child whose gap spaces nothing (named deviation).

Titre.description: Title, h1 (accessibilite-home-odoo, 2026-09-04: the token name carries the level). Rides the responsive text style H1 (recognised by the extraction on the set): size 32/32/40/54 and line-height 40/40/50/68 by viewport mode come from typography.h1.* (tokens/modes/viewport.*), weight SemiBold — the 2.0.0 master drew 54 Bold without a style (named weight change, owner decision). Centered on Mobile/Tablette, left on Desktop/Wide (declared + stylesWhen: the only text-alignment channel). Bold ranges stay governed by content.marks.strong.

sousTitre.description: Rich Hero paragraph bound to the native SousTitre text property; `sousTitre2` decides whether it occupies any space. No Figma text style on the node (body has none): the bindings are set by hand to the responsive body tokens — size 16/16/18/18 and line-height 24/24/27/27 (typography.body.size / line-height), weight Regular on Mobile/Tablette and Medium on Desktop/Wide (typography.body.weight varies by viewport mode; the extraction minted a uniform 500, wrong for Mobile/Tablette — renamed, nothing minted). The 2.0.0 master drew 24/32 Medium: size drops in Wide (owner decision). letter-spacing 0 is the UA default, not carried. Centered on Mobile/Tablette, left on Desktop/Wide. Bold ranges governed by content.marks.strong.

Bouton.description: CTA, Outline blanc, right icon on the four variants (unlike HeroVideo). ONE named deviation from the canvas, because the schema has no channel on a nested instance (stylesWhen / layoutByProp / declared are refused on component parts — the child contract owns its styling): on Mobile/Tablette the canvas pins the CTA ABSOLUTE to the bottom edge, full width inside the gutter (bottom 64 = padding-bottom, inset 24 / 48 = padding-inline, drawn 342 / 738 wide) — here it stays in the flow under the paragraph (gap 24); the Odoo projection applies the pin under the desktop breakpoint as a code-only fact (responsive/hero.pqr.css). On Desktop/Wide it is HUG, in the flow, at the right of the row (354 / 386 wide on the canvas).
